verdict.airi_n170: N170 has no AIRI script (D12). The MEG plotting Q(c,i) analog applied to windowed N170 RDMs still yields ~1, not 0.82.
verdict.eq2_sample_inner_note: Eq. 2 RHS with MATLAB sample SD is (n-1)/n * r = 5/6 * r. Face window → 0.83323 (closest paper-formula number to 0.82). The same formula on the car window is 0.83327, which cannot be the published >0.99. Therefore this reading is not how both figures were computed.
verdict.expectedness: ReDisCA/SPoC maximizes a covariance proxy of corr(w^T R_ij w, d_ij) over 28 channels and ~26 window samples. A 6-entry two-level target (3 between, 3 within) is a low-dimensional constraint; a leading component that isolates one condition from the other three routinely drives unique-triangle Pearson to ~1. A library GEP that matches that target near-perfectly is the expected optimum, not a bug.
verdict.opposite_full_epoch_pattern: Official averages: face full-epoch unique Pearson 0.94466 > car full-epoch 0.48594. Paper: face 0.82 < car >0.99. Windowed unique Pearson is ~1 for both contrasts.
verdict.stock_spoc: Stock SPoC does not compute an RDM correlation (stock_spoc.md: SPoC does not know about RDMs).
